note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). Three portal/app screens and one terminal screen (script, run on the laptop). The Dataverse token and the org URL live only in environment variables of the recording session and are never printed.
prepare: Push-Location .\src; python -m bpfkit validate process/purchase-request-process.json; Pop-Location

# owner signs in: az login (token for the Dataverse Web API), pac auth below, and the browser profiles for labadmin (make.powerapps.com, make.powerautomate.com), alex.demo (Purchasing app) and jordan.demo (Outlook on the web). Nothing is typed or stored here.
pac auth create --name dev --environment $env:DEV_URL   # owner signs in, off camera
$env:DATAVERSE_TOKEN = az account get-access-token --resource $env:DV_ORG --query accessToken -o tsv   # owner signs in (az login), never echoed

# owner (tenant, demo.md Setup 1-4): solution Purchase BPF (PurchaseBpf, publisher contoso, prefix cts), table Purchase request with business process flow fields, model-driven app Purchasing, security role Purchasing user for alex.demo, the BPF 'Purchase request process' built from src\process (Amount added to Manager review only after the branch-rule failure is filmed)

# owner (demo.md Setup 6-7): create the connection references (Dataverse, Approvals), point the finance address to the finance-approvers group, turn both flows on, add the Flow step 'Finance review step' to the Finance review stage and re-activate the BPF; as alex.demo create 'Ergonomic chairs' 1,800 and 'Laptops for two new developers' 12,500 with justifications; Jordan Demo answers the finance approval in Outlook

screens.name: designer
steps: Select environment DEV, open Solutions > Purchase BPF and open the business process flow 'Purchase request process' in the designer
Show the stages Submit and Manager review, then the Condition tile with both rules (Amount greater than or equal to 5000 AND Manager decision equals Approved)
Show Finance review on the Yes branch with the flow step 'Request finance approval', then Order and Close
mask: org URL (*.crm4.dynamics.com) in the address bar
tenant name in the top bar

screens.name: gate
screens.app: Purchasing (model-driven app, in the browser as alex.demo)
steps: Open a Purchase request form for Alex Demo with the process bar on the Submit stage and Justification empty (required marker)
Select Next Stage and show the required-field error
Second take, same shot: fill Justification and select Next Stage again; the bar moves to Manager review
Optional: try a required Two Options column on a throwaway step to confirm that No does not pass
mask: org URL in the address bar

screens.name: flowrun
steps: Open the run history of 'Finance review step' for the 12,500 EUR request
Show Parse step payload, Get purchase request, Finance approval, Finance decision (Approve branch) and Complete flow step, all green
Next to it open the form and show the Finance review stage with the step Completed
Optional cut-in: Jordan Demo's approval mail in Outlook on the web
mask: org URL in the address bar and the run inputs

screens.name: script
mask: org URL in the printed PATCH
the form's process bar next to it shows the new active stage; mask the org URL there too

teardown: # owner (tenant): turn both flows off; delete the solution Purchase BPF including its components (BPF, table cts_purchaserequest, connection references); delete the role Purchasing user; keep finance-approvers if episode 15 reuses it
Remove-Item Env:DATAVERSE_TOKEN, Env:BPF_INSTANCE, Env:DV_ORG, Env:DEV_URL -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
